name: C. S. Grindall
role: E S G ranch owner, Beaver creek; deputy sheriff at Mingusville
bio: C. S. Grindall ran the E S G ranch on Beaver creek near Mingusville, Montana, and in April 1885 went east with his family planning to buy between five hundred and a thousand States cattle for it. That same month he was riding in the locomotive cab during a train wreck and escaped unhurt. In summer 1885 he advertised a strayed horse from Mingusville, and in October 1885 he was appointed deputy sheriff by Sheriff Tuttle of Glendive, still holding that post when he reported on Beaver valley cattle in June 1886.
